verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a built-in, in-product search bar on hosted docs sites. Its ranking is relevance-based: a configurable `boost` multiplier is applied to each chunk's relevance score, and there are result limits and product/version filters. That covers the relevance-ranked, out-of-the-box core of the story, but nothing in the evidence addresses typo tolerance or search speed. missing for 10: evidence of typo/fuzzy tolerance, evidence of search speed/latency, explicit confirmation of whole-site indexing, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, readers get fast, typo-tolerant, relevance-ranked search over the whole docs site out of the box

citations.quote: Configure the in-product search bar on your Mintlify-hosted documentation site: ranking boosts, maximum results per query, and product and version search filters.
The value is a numeric multiplier applied to each chunk's relevance score
